sites.ownership: Application controller owns the active-window slot for single-window lifecycle management.
sites.justification: Keeps one editor window alive and replaceable without global mutable state.

sites.ownership: GTK test hooks reuse the shared active-window slot.
sites.justification: Exercises action and lifecycle wiring against the same single-window state model used at runtime.

sites.ownership: GTK test helper borrows the shared active-window slot.
sites.justification: Allows coverage of window reuse logic without introducing a second mutable state path.

sites.ownership: Application actions borrow the shared window slot.
sites.justification: Routes app-scoped commands to the active editor window without object data hacks.

sites.ownership: Lifecycle handlers reuse the shared window slot.
sites.justification: Activation and file-open signals must reuse or create the single editor window.

sites.ownership: Window creation helper updates the active-window slot.
sites.justification: Creation and teardown need one mutable slot to avoid duplicate primary windows.

sites.ownership: Window controller owns the mutable document snapshot.
sites.justification: Document metadata changes independently of GTK widget ownership during async file operations.

sites.ownership: Window controller owns the deferred action slot.
sites.justification: Unsaved-changes confirmation needs to remember the next user action across dialog callbacks.

sites.ownership: Window controller owns the close-guard flag.
sites.justification: Prevents duplicate confirmation prompts after the user already approved closing.

sites.ownership: GTK coverage helper reuses the single-window slot.
sites.justification: Test-only helper drives the same shared state shape as runtime action dispatch.

sites.ownership: GTK dialog helper reuses the single-window slot.
sites.justification: Test-only helper validates dialog wiring against the runtime window ownership model.
